description: This PHP source file defines a class for generating and configuring ad layer styles, specifically for a 'floater' style in an ad server plugin. It includes methods for rendering configuration UI, generating ad layer code with parameters, and handling color picker scripts.

classes.name: Plugins_oxInvocationTags_Adlayer_Layerstyles_Floater_Invocation
classes.description: Class for configuring and generating code for a floating ad layer style in an invocation tag plugin.

methods.name: placeLayerSettings
methods.description: Renders HTML form for configuring ad layer style parameters.

methods.name: generateLayerCode
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to display the ad layer with configured parameters.

methods.name: getlayerShowVar
methods.description: Returns configuration for variables used in ad layer generators.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to a two-digit uppercase hexadecimal string.

methods.name: settings_cp_map
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript and HTML for a color picker map, used in background color selection.
